requirements.sourceBehavior: Credential precedence equals current Claude
requirements.evidence: fixtures/credential-precedence.json; src/auth.ts
requirements.piMapping: Pi stored credentials before ambient resolver
requirements.gap: Ambient ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN versus setup-token order now matches measured print mode. When ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN are both set, Claude sends Bearer for the auth token and still sends x-api-key. Claude also prefers ANTHROPIC_API_KEY over a setup token. This provider rejects API-key fallback and does not emit both headers. Claude ignores ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN, which remains a lower-priority alias. Stored-versus-environment order and interactive TUI precedence were not measured.
